Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the parking lot collision you
reported in Sugar Land. Before we begin, do you consent to this call bieng recorded?
A: Yes, that's fine.
Q: Could you describe where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was backing out of a parking space near the entrance of the shopping center. It was a busy afternoon, and I was
looking for a gap in traffic.
Q: What happened as you were backing up?
A: I felt a bump on the passenger side of my car. I stopped right away. The other vehicle was coming through the
aisle, and I didn't see it until the impact.
Q: How fast were you moving at the time?
A: Slowly, maybe walking pace. I'd only just started to reverse.
Q: Did you or anyone else get out of the vehicles?
A: The other driver got out and came over. I stayed in my seat for a few minutes because my head was pounding and
I felt dizzy.
Q: Have you been seen by a medical provider since the collision?
A: Yes, I went to urgent care that evening. They said I had a concussion. I've been told to rest, avoid screens for long
periods, and not drive much while my symptoms settle.
Q: How are you feeling right now?
A: Better than the first few days, but I still get headaches and sometimes I lose my train of thought. Bright light
bothers me.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I want to cooperate fully. I've kept the urgent care paperwork and I can send it to you.
Q: Thank you. We'll follow up once we've reviewed the documents. That concludes the statement.
</page>

  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
